Only the most elite among them were allowed to outfit their mounts with it.|Inventory|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== The Knight's Saddle is a type of [[Saddle]] that is given to [[Link]] by [[Jini]]. It can be obtained by hitting 23-25 targets during the [[Horseback Archery]] [[Mini-Game]].{{Cite|Tell you what... You break {{Color BotW|Red|more than 20}} targets, and I'll hand over my {{Color BotW|Red|horse gear}}.|Jini|BotW}}{{Cite|Hm...{{Color BotW|Red|[X] targets}}... It's been a dog's age since I've seen such talent in someone so young. What do you mean you're not that young? Over 100 years old? Go ahead, pull the other one. Anyway, this gift is my thanks for putting on a good show. I'm past needing it, and I think you should have it.|Jini|BotW}} These Saddles were used by the most elite of the [[Knight of Hyrule|Knights of Hyrule]] for their [[Horse]]s. The Knight's Saddle belongs to the [[Knight's Gear]] set of [[Horse Gear]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 161}} Link can have his Horses equipped with a Knight's Saddle at [[Highland Stable]], [[South Akkala Stable]], [[Outskirt Stable]], and [[Woodland Stable]].{{Cite|Change to {{Color BotW|Red|Knight's Saddle}}?|Canni|BotW}} Like other Saddles, however, workers are unable to put them on [[Epona]] or the [[Giant Horse]].{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out her {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? Actually, this horse is different from any I've ever seen before. My, she's so lovely and graceful... I'm sorry, but I'm pretty sure this little lady would absolutely hate it if you changed her mane or gear. I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}}{{Cite|Hello there! That's a mighty find horse you have. If you like, I can change out its {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} or maybe... Oh? My goodness, that's no pony, is it? It's so big! I'm sorry, but I don't think I have any {{Color BotW|Blue|gear}} that'd fit such a large horse, and I bet it wouldn't like its {{Color BotW|Blue|mane}} handled... I'm so sorry about that.|Canni|BotW}} ==={{TotK|-}}=== The Knight's Saddle is set to reappear in {{TotK}}. [[Link]] can equip it to his [[Horse]]s. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Horse Gear * Knight's Bridle * Saddle }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Horse Gear, Knight's Gear, Saddles |items= BotW, TotK |key-items= BotW, TotK }}
